title: Request Routing Flow
creator: Katie Jo Schuman
subject: AI economics
description: The learner will explain which path through cache, small model, quality check, large model, and fallback model each of five example requests takes and what it costs.

learningObjectives: The learner will explain which path through cache, small model, quality check, large model, and fallback model each of five example requests takes and what it costs.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit-then-explore: predict, receive feedback, then explore
commonMisconceptions: (1) Every request reaches a model. (2) Escalated requests pay only for the large model. (3) A fallback model is used whenever the small model is wrong.
assessmentOpportunities: For each of five requests the learner selects, before the trace is shown, the node where the request is answered. A selection is correct when it matches the "Answered at" column. Mastery is 4 of 5 correct on the first attempt. Opening a node's description is exploration, not evidence.
